entities.name: UvrC Q5X1P5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5X1P5 from Legionella pneumophila strain Paris; 618 aa.
UvrC is the dual-incision nuclease of the bacterial UvrABC nucleotide-excision repair system.
N-terminal half performs the 3-prime incision and C-terminal half performs the 5-prime incision of DNA lesions.
Annotated as cytoplasmic, DNA-binding, and part of the excinuclease repair complex; interacts with UvrB.
Associated biological processes include nucleotide-excision repair and SOS response.

entities.name: Nucleotide-excision repair
observations: UvrC participates in bacterial nucleotide-excision repair by making dual DNA incisions around a lesion.
